findings.observation: Node computes margin from contract total; formal design computes confirmed receipts net minus included cost net, divided by confirmed receipts net; zero receipts yields null ratio.
findings.decision: Root explicitly accepted formal design formula on 2026-11-06; Rust must diverge from Node test numeric assertions.

findings.observation: Receipt producer has only receipt_amount/date/status, no immutable tax/currency/snapshot basis. Confirmed cash cannot be certified as net income by relabelling or current-rate guessing.
findings.proposal: Freeze gross cash semantics + confirmation-time immutable net/tax basis, explicit snapshot id/version and currency; preserve legacy-unverified rows; see receiptBasis.

findings.observation: No business producer sets included status/flag; stage producer ends at confirmed. Source-chain nodes coexist and must not all be summed. Invoice has no payable/payment relation and no net/tax split; ambiguous links cannot be inferred from amount/date/project.
findings.proposal: Explicit include/exclude decisions on real source-chain basis, mandatory reasons/expected versions, default payment actual basis, invoice tax support only, procurement exception explicit. No synthetic included fixture.

findings.observation: Four commands accept authoritative money, tax summaries, action level and baseline version from client; baseline reference UUID/changePackageId are not bound to approved business producer; restatement bypasses rebaseline/date range validation in merge.
findings.proposal: Commands accept source identities/versions, explicit inclusion choices and reason; server derives all money/conclusions. Reject legacy authoritative money fields in revised strict DTO, or assertion-only fields with exact equality if Root explicitly freezes transition.

findings.observation: Technical-cost producer is project-level; sourceFacts pins package id/version, handover records pin before/after chains. Cannot sum the same project estimate for each contract or treat contract signed amount delta as cost delta.
findings.proposal: Freeze original adopted project estimate package once; preserve before/after rebaseline package lineage; derive approved execution change deltas from real cost-version transitions. Distinct conflicting project estimate packages require explicit approved selection, never first-row choice.

findings.observation: Node preflight version/existence reads do not establish the Rust required transaction/lock protocol; baseline nativeUpdate omits CAS. Period and project snapshots have no shared root/source hash to prove restated history belongs to the period.
findings.proposal: Single outerTX; source locks; explicit status/version CAS; stable period anchor to paired ProjectOperatingSnapshot; same-period restatement lineage and unique successor; retain original period bytes.

findings.observation: Nine G DTO outputs expose raw financial strings under finance:manage; contract is not protected by operating/labor sensitive projection. Unknown net amount cannot honestly use default zero.
findings.proposal: Root freezes financial grouped projection + containsLabor intersection, amount-state/legacy certification, non-reconstructive compatibility nulls; G reuses registered projection mechanism and transactional security writes.

findings.observation: All four command 201 responses have description only; their real CommandResult is not represented by current response schema.
findings.proposal: Root assigns concrete CommandResult schema to four 201 responses and regenerates full clients after DTO freeze.

findings.observation: periodKey is an arbitrary nonempty string and period snapshots have no business window, currency, source evidence or paired snapshot reference. A current-state aggregate cannot certify an old-period as-of result.
findings.proposal: Validate month/ISO week; freeze business timezone (existing cost pipeline Hong Kong), business cutoff plus capture/knowledge cutoff; retain source membership and reconstruct effective contract/baseline versions as of cutoff; fail missing temporal provenance.
